headline: Southern New Hampshire pull clear at the top
dek: Southern New Hampshire have won all three of their conference matches, the latest by seven goals at Pace, while Bentley's home defeat to American International leaves those two programmes level on six points behind them. Nine matches into the season, they remain the only side without a defeat.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's thirty-six goals come from at least fifteen different scorers, so the tallest bar is not one player's work; Southern Connecticut, shortest on the chart with nine, have drawn four of their seven matches and lost only two, so the shortest bar is not the worst record.

wire.line: Southern New Hampshire are the last programme yet to lose after Saint Anselm ended Pace's unbeaten start.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern New Hampshire have won seven matches and drawn two, and are the only programme without a defeat.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cody Holbert has scored nine of Assumption's nineteen goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Michael's have lost six matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Franklin Pierce's home defeat to Charleston is their second of the season, and both have come against non-conference opponents; their record stands at four wins, two draws and two losses.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Joe Zweben has made fifty saves, more than any other goalkeeper listed.

last_match.line: Franklin Pierce have yet to lose a conference match; both of their defeats have come against non-conference sides.

next_match.line: Southern New Hampshire have yet to lose; Assumption arrive off consecutive defeats, at Bentley and at home to Queens.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
